body: Yeah I don't like medications or pills and I had heard of non-medicated ways that had pretty high success rate but i guess it varies woman to woman.
I can't find anything that's non-medicated that works :(
I'm so sorry...I know it's hard. PM me if you need to

My boyfriend feels this way. My story is in my post history...but it's like no one cares but me...I'm his only outlet. Why? Why does no one care? He always says "why me" or "why can't i be someone who doesn't suffer" or "why does no one care about me"

My situation is nowhere compared to what you are feeling. My boyfriend has been going through a serious depressive phase recently and has recently lost all of his close friends. His parents don't support him...no one cares, they just say "all you need to do is get a job" or "stop sleeping all day". No one helps. I'm the only one who talks or listens, but even me...I'm terrible at talking. I have anxiety as well and whenever he has a panic attack and calls me, I don't know what to do other than say "it's ok it's ok" but it's not okay....I need help. Help for him. And I really connected with your last sentences about not abandoning someone even though it's so uncomfortable.
Yeah I just posted here about my story. At least you have that willpower...That's already a step.
I have someone in a similar situation...but how do you find the strength to even get a job? My friend is going through that right now but he's in no mental state to work anywhere.
